description: WP-G2 Codex: Orks (11e) DEFF FROM THE SHADOWS (Boss Snikrot, first battle round onwards) through the real UI. Fixture ork11e_g2_deff_shadows: battle round 1, P2 (Custodes) is active, Boss Snikrot is in P1's strategic reserves. P2 ends the Movement phase with the phase button: the end-of-Movement prompt opens for PLAYER 1 even in battle round 1 (RAPID INGRESS itself cannot be used then), headed DEFF FROM THE SHADOWS with a free 'Arrive (free)' row. A real click on it spends no CP and starts the ingress set-up; a real board click sets Snikrot up wholly within 6" of the left battlefield edge, more than 8" from every enemy and outside P2's deployment zone, and a real click on Confirm completes the ingress move.

steps.comment: movement_phase_start windows (not under test) are declined
the phase waits for the Ork player's decision
Deff from the Shadows costs no CP
left edge, mid-board: wholly within 6" of an edge, > 8" from the enemy, outside P2's deployment zone
DEPLOYED by the ingress move in battle round 1

steps.script:
var p = GameState.get_unit("U_BOSS_SNIKROT_A").models[0].position
return absf(float(p.x) - 40.0) < 2.0 and absf(float(p.y) - 1200.0) < 2.0
